hypothesis: Using only the prior sealed daily universe and the last 720 closed one-minute returns, cross-sectional adaptive-LASSO forecasts contain enough short-horizon information spillover for an equal-weight top-quintile long and bottom-quintile short Binance USDT-M portfolio, rebalanced every ten minutes with a one-minute latency floor, to retain positive expectancy after current measured turnover costs and funding.

activation.kline_input_days: each phase's evaluation days plus exactly one preceding causal-lookback UTC day
activation.archive_inventory: for every prior-day eligible symbol: membership-day and evaluation-day one-minute klines plus evaluation-day aggTrades and sealed daily funding history; reject duplicate, missing, or extra files
activation.archive_symbol_mapping: CCXT BASE/USDT:USDT maps exactly to Binance BASEUSDT
activation.aggtrade_midnight_continuity: require exact aggregate-trade ID continuation across adjacent included UTC days for each symbol

model.predictors: all cross-sectional lagged one-minute returns including own lag
model.penalty_selection: first 600 chronological pairs fit, final 120 pairs forward validation, minimum one-step return MSE over the fixed lambda-fraction grid, larger lambda wins an exact tie

portfolio.return_timestamp_contract: a kline opened at t-1 is labelled at its fully observable close boundary t; a decision at t may read returns through t
portfolio.latency_interpretation: entry at t+1 excludes the forecasted t-to-t+1 minute and tests rank persistence over the subsequent holding interval
portfolio.execution_price_reference: first verified aggTrade at or after each entry or exit boundary
portfolio.missing_execution_reference_action: reject the complete UTC day; no forward fill or kline substitution
portfolio.boundary_rebalance: direct net rebalance from the expiring target to the new target at their shared boundary; first target enters from cash and final target exits to cash

costs.turnover_definition: L1 signed-weight change from boundary-marked pretrade holdings to the new target; target-to-target turnover is only a lower-bound diagnostic and no synthetic flat round trip is charged
costs.funding_formula: for every funding event in [entry, exit), add negative position_weight times funding_rate
costs.development_funding_source: sealed per-symbol per-day public funding-history API response restricted to authorized evaluation days
costs.final_funding_reconciliation: required against Binance monthly fundingRate ZIP and publisher CHECKSUM after locked validation is legitimately opened

statistical_contract.daily_observation: one complete UTC-day base-net return compounded from 143 non-overlapping intervals
statistical_contract.selection_bias_single_preregistered_tria: NOT_APPLICABLE_SINGLE_PREREGISTERED_TRIAL only; never a promotion pass

checks.source_integrity: all 120 authorized development UTC days each expose exactly 143 same-day execution windows; prior-day memberships, one-minute grids, aggTrade IDs, archive checksums, sealed daily funding responses, and decision timestamps pass

development_gate.failure_action: FAIL and keep locked validation inaccessible; do not change bucket count, timing, lambda grid, costs, or universe after seeing returns

locked_validation_gate.pass_mapping: REVIEW only, never direct live promotion

post_validation_requirements: forward long-entry, long-exit, short-entry, short-exit, protective-stop, latency, and impact calibration on the selected symbols
portfolio-level capital-preservation gate: maximum cost-after MTM drawdown at or below 10% and positive long-horizon cost-after expectancy; monthly return is not a gate
portfolio maximum drawdown, liquidation, ruin, concentration, selection-bias, and source-replay gates
explicit live-promotion receipt and separate user authorization

opening Experiment 0015 before a verified activation lock exists
acquiring or summarizing project return archives before the final preregistration receipt
using the final 60 days during development
opening a development position whose entry or exit crosses into a locked-validation UTC day
choosing 5-minute, 13-minute, decile, direction, symbols, or costs after observing results
